description.value: Charqui is a gastropub and resto-bar that has anchored the Kitsilano neighbourhood since 2007, known for its wings, craft beer selection, and lively entertainment programming including live music and karaoke. It sits on Cornwall Avenue, close to the popular Kitsilano Beach cycling corridor along the Vancouver waterfront. Indoor and outdoor seating are both available.
